note: coverage only, no red possible: the hazard is not reachable at c8099ec3a^. A level is retired (SetIdle, from Process or StopNowImpl) while holding its own m_playlistMutex, and SetIdle sets m_status IDLE first; the only breadcrumb walk, GetCurrentStatus, takes that same mutex and returns before GetParentPlaylistNames when the level is idle, and StopNow/StopGracefully/Play on a retired snapshot redirect to the current playlist (CurrentIfNotThis) before StopGracefullyImpl walks m_parent. So no thread reads a retired child's m_parent, and a status thread delayed inside the walk would hold the child's mutex and so block its retirement. Off-thread reads of m_parent all happen under the child's mutex while its ancestors are not current, so none races a write (passes on both sides under ASan and TSan, per the earlier runs). No revert proof on master either: 4a22890ad made m_parent shared ownership, so leaving it set there only delays the parent's release
